title: Turing machine round
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine, let $a$ be a state, let $E$ be a set of optional states, and let $P$ be a predicate on work-tape head positions. For configurations $c$ and $c'$ on a fixed input and a natural number $t$, require that $c$ starts in state $a$, that $t>0$, and that after exactly $t$ steps the machine reaches $c'$ with state in $ igl\{a\bigr\}\cup E$. At every intermediate time $u$ with $0<u<t$, the state must lie outside the union of $E$, the state $a$, and the halting state; throughout times $0$ through $t$, the work-tape head positions must satisfy $P$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of work tapes
A symbol alphabet and state type
A set E of optional states
A predicate on work-tape head positions
Configurations c and c' on a fixed input
The endpoint state is a or belongs to E
At positive intermediate times before t, the state is outside E, a, and the halting state
P holds on head positions at every time through t
